official_content.allowed_repository_scope: human-reviewed factual transcription with source attribution

policy.product_identity: unofficial fan-maintained collection tooling; no endorsement implied

community_current_datasets.policy: A maintained community-current provider must receive a reviewed source entry before production adoption.

simulation_reference_datasets.policy: Simulation/reference datasets must receive a reviewed source entry before production adoption.

remote_runtime_assets.policy: Remote scripts, stylesheets, fonts, icons, and images are rejected by the source audit unless a future reviewed exception is implemented.

source.project: Pokémon GO official announcements / Scopely Explore
source.exact_version: Scopely Explore Terms last modified 2026-07-15; repository source review 2026-08-29

review.basis: Repository-authored factual metadata only; this record does not assert a license to upstream site Content. Automated scraping is prohibited by repository policy and current source terms were reviewed separately.

attribution.text: Pokémon GO official announcements are cited at the record/snapshot level. Article prose, images, and visual assets are excluded.

permissions.redistribution_scope: Repository-authored factual transcription fields with source attribution only; no upstream prose or visual Content is republished.

sources.authority: Official announcement for the factual fields explicitly reviewed and cited

acquisition.method: Human-reviewed factual transcription into committed provider JSON

replacement.remove_or_replace: If terms or source availability change, stop updating the provider, preserve provenance only where permitted, remove active provider inputs/claims, and adopt a newly reviewed source before restoring current-data features.

review.basis: Compatibility with a user-supplied export. No Poke Genie application code, artwork, screenshots, prose, or proprietary visual assets are copied by this repository.

attribution.text: Collection pages identify Poke Genie as the source export format for transparency.

permissions.redistribution_scope: User-supplied collection facts and the repository's normalized representation; no upstream app content license is asserted.

sources.authority: User export for owned collection facts and Poke Genie-calculated IV-ranking fields

acquisition.method: User commits timestamped CSV export; build selects the newest valid export

replacement.remove_or_replace: If the export format or permitted use changes, stop accepting new exports until parser and source-policy review are updated together; existing user-owned data can be migrated to a documented replacement format.

review.basis: Species and character names are used descriptively to identify collection records. This record does not assert a license to Pokémon trademarks, artwork, logos, sprites, icons, or other visual assets.

attribution.text: Pokémon and Pokémon character names/trademarks belong to their respective owners; this repository is an unofficial fan-maintained project and does not imply endorsement.

permissions.redistribution_scope: Descriptive identifiers in collection/reference data only.

sources.authority: Identifiers inherited from user exports and the pinned reviewed reference dataset

acquisition.method: Identifiers arrive through registered user-export and pinned-reference sources

replacement.remove_or_replace: Remove affected identifiers or replace the reference source and UI labels if a reviewed rights/terms change requires it; do not substitute official visual assets.

review.basis: Exact versions and declared license identifiers are inventoried from package-lock.json during the build provenance audit. These packages are development/test tooling and are not loaded from third-party origins at runtime.

acquisition.method: npm ci from package-lock.json in CI

replacement.remove_or_replace: Remove or replace a dependency through the lockfile and rerun dependency/license review before merging.
